# Claude Code Coaching by Ahmad Shayan

> Private 1-on-1 coaching that takes a non-technical operator from zero to a deployed AI tool, usually in one or two live sessions. $250 flat, full refund if nothing ships.

The premise: you do not learn to code. You learn to direct Claude Code, which writes the code. Setup is point-and-click. Building is conversational. You prompt, Claude codes, and you finish with working software you own.

This site is JavaScript-rendered, so a crawler that does not execute JS receives an empty page body. There are only two pages, so this file carries the full content as plain text.

Several people share the name Ahmad Shayan. This is the one who founded Ahmasoft, an AI software company in Lahore, Pakistan. He is not the concrete-durability researcher of the same name. His canonical identifier in structured data is `https://ahmadshayan.com/#ahmad-shayan`.

## The offer

- Price: $250 flat for the Builder Sprint
- Format: one or two live sessions, typically about 90 minutes each
- Outcome: a working AI tool deployed to your own accounts
- Guarantee: full $250 refund if nothing is deployed by the end of your Sprint
- After the Sprint: ongoing coaching at $50/hr, taken up by roughly 70% of clients
- The first discovery call is free

## Who it is for

Non-technical professionals who want to build their own tools rather than wait on a backlog. Most clients are VPs and directors with no coding background, including senior leaders at NVIDIA.

## Frequently asked questions

**Do I need to be technical?** No. Most clients are VPs and directors with no coding background. Setup is point-and-click. Building is conversational. You prompt, Claude codes.

**How long does the Sprint take?** Most clients finish in two sessions of about 90 minutes each. Technical clients often do two sessions of an hour each. Some prefer one longer sitting. We pace to fit you, not a fixed clock.

**What if I do not know what I want to build?** That is what the first 10 minutes are for. Clients arrive with a vague idea and leave with a concrete plan.

**Will I need to pay for Claude API?** Yes, but it is small. Plan on $5 to $15 a month as you build. Cost controls are covered in Session 1.

**What happens after the Sprint?** You leave with everything working and a recall doc as your reference. About 70% of clients come back for ongoing coaching at $50/hr. The rest take it from there on their own.

**What is the refund policy?** If you do not have a working AI tool deployed by the end of your Sprint, the full $250 is refunded. No forms, no friction.
